verdict.rationale: Carta documents a Capitalization Table endpoint plus stakeholder, option grant, and convertible note endpoints, accessible via OAuth 2.0 client credentials without per-user consent. It also offers an official Claude MCP cap-table plugin for querying ownership, SAFEs, grants, and financing history in natural language, so an agent can pull the current cap table programmatically. The reconciliation against a data room would have to be done by the agent itself. Missing for 10: any documented data-room integration or reconciliation workflow, non-alpha API stability (endpoints are v1alpha1), machine-readable OpenAPI or llms.txt for agents (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
